forecasts.question: Will Iran transmit a formal written counter-proposal to the United States — via Qatar or Omani mediators — responding to US positions exchanged at the September 23 UNGA talks, before EOD 2026-10-03?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 72h forecast. Iran tabled a 10-point roadmap orally at UNGA September 23. Araghchi held follow-on consultations with Qatar's Prime Minister and Foreign Minister in Doha on September 29, covering Hormuz sequencing, HEU disposition, and confidence-building measures. Iran has historically preferred oral or back-channel transmissions over formal written proposals. The short 72h window and Tehran's stated insistence on a US gesture first reduces the probability of a formal written document within this period, though a structured working document via Qatar is plausible.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Reuters, AP, Al Jazeera, or official Qatari or Omani government source confirms that Iran transmitted a formal written document or structured counter-proposal to the US side via mediators by EOD 2026-10-03.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: At least one TIER1 source (Reuters, AP, AFP, Al Jazeera, Oman Observer) citing a mediator or named official government source confirming document transmission.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If Iran publicly releases a roadmap or plan without mediator confirmation it reached the US side formally, score AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. A verbal readout from a mediator without document confirmation = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will the Netanyahu-led bloc (Likud plus Shas, UTJ, Otzma Yehudit, and Religious Zionism) win at least 61 combined seats in the October 27, 2026 Israeli legislative election?
forecasts.delta_reason: New forecast. Current poll averages place the right-wing and religious coalition bloc at 50-54 seats versus the opposition at 54-58 seats. The bloc needs 61 to govern. In four of five recent September surveys the opposition bloc holds the advantage. Structural challenges: Ben-Gvir and Otzma Yehudit threshold risk, haredi party fatigue, and war-blame narrative hurting Netanyahu personally. A 7-11 seat deficit 27 days out is a large gap to close. One i24NEWS outlier showed Netanyahu bloc at approximately 62 seats but was not corroborated by other survey houses.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if official Central Elections Committee of Israel results show the combined Netanyahu-led bloc (Likud, Shas, UTJ, Otzma Yehudit, Religious Zionism) winning 61 or more combined Knesset seats on October 27, 2026.

forecasts.question: Will the United States and Iran formally announce a comprehensive ceasefire framework or binding agreement before EOD 2026-12-31?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 92-day forecast. September UNGA cycle demonstrated renewed diplomatic momentum: Muscat talks Sep 12-13, UNGA sidelines Sep 23 ('very good' per Trump), Iran 10-point roadmap covering regionwide ceasefire and phased Hormuz reopening, and ongoing Qatar mediation through Sep 29. However, the core sequencing impasse — US demands nuclear agenda first; Iran demands blockade removal and sanctions relief first — has not narrowed. Trump ruled out lifting the blockade before Iran demonstrates goodwill. The April 2026 ceasefire precedent showed fragility. The October 27 Israeli election and post-election coalition formation could add 4-8 weeks of US attention fragmentation. Three active mediation channels (Oman, Qatar, Pakistan) keep the track alive.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a joint or coordinated US-Iranian announcement, or a trilateral mediator announcement, confirms a signed ceasefire framework, formal peace agreement, or binding MOU governing cessation of hostilities, before EOD 2026-12-31.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Official government sources from both parties or a mediator country, confirmed by Reuters or AP with at least one named US or Iranian official.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: A unilateral ceasefire declaration by one side not acknowledged by the other does not meet the criterion. A 'framework' that lacks binding commitments on cessation of hostilities resolves AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. A temporary ceasefire without a binding framework resolves AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: PROVISIONAL RESOLVED-NO — human review required. The 25th Knesset completed its full four-year term and was dissolved naturally on 2026-07-17, the first such natural expiry since 1988. Seat-count at dissolution is disputed: Source B (Analyst) states coalition maintained one-seat majority (approximately 61 seats) through dissolution — 'dissolve early' criterion not met; RESOLVED-NO. Source A (DA) states coalition held approximately 50-52 seats at dissolution (below 61 threshold) — if accurate, the ambiguity_rule caretaker clause applies ('If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES') and resolution would reverse to YES. The two source claims are mutually exclusive. Human verification of the coalition seat count at July 17 dissolution is required before this resolution is finalized.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.

forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

forecasts.question: Will commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz reach >=30 vessels/day (7-day rolling average) before EOD 2026-10-03?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO early (Sep 30, 3 days before horizon). The 7-day rolling average of commercial transits through the Strait held at 8-17 vessels/day throughout September — 87-94% below the pre-war baseline of approximately 125/day. The week of September 16-23 recorded approximately 55 total transits (roughly 8/day). With a current base of 8-17 vessels/day, reaching a 7-day rolling average of 30 by October 3 would require all three remaining days to average approximately 90 or more transits — mathematically unreachable. The Iran-Oman shipping corridor was discussed but did not become operational. IRGC maritime enforcement continues. Resolving early; threshold was never approached.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if any AIS-based ship-tracking source (IMF PortWatch, Straits.live, MarineTraffic, Lloyd's List Intelligence) records >=30 commercial transits/day as a 7-day rolling average at any point between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-03.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: AIS-based tracker plus one TIER1 or OSINT confirmation (Bloomberg, Reuters, Lloyd's List).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval escort vessels and warships do not count toward commercial transit; if trackers diverge by >20%, flag AMBIGUOUS.
